finding.impact: A static visible root Settings fixture may stop progressing pending screenshot readback before the callback can wake the event loop.
source_chain: App::poll app.rs:446 stops periodic repaint after screenshot_requested is true; :449 still consumes events for root Settings through App::logic :3657.
egui-wgpu winit.rs:733 submits copy commands before read_screen_rgba at :753 registers map_async in capture.rs:207.
capture.rs:240 requests repaint only after the map callback succeeds.
WGPU29 buffer.rs:538-545 requires a subsequent submit/device poll/instance poll to drive callbacks; no explicit device/instance poll exists in the inspected native renderer path.
egui context.rs:138-140 gives an immediate repaint request one outstanding pass, not a bounded continuous progress loop.
finding.recommended_small_repair: While the single screenshot request remains pending, keep scheduling periodic ROOT repaints (for example the existing 100ms interval) so later submissions service map callbacks. Do not reissue the Screenshot command; keep the existing 30-second supervisor bound.
finding.confidence: The missing pending-readback progress loop is source-confirmed and consistent with the retained trace. The trace lacks renderer map/poll stages, so it does not establish this as the sole empirical hosted GPU cause.

limitations: No code edits, Cargo builds, tests, GUI/API execution, capture or models by evaluator.
No empirical repair pass claimed; five reported passes do not erase the dashboard timeout.
Current uncommitted wgpu_integration differs for the independently diagnosed child-viewport patch; tested-runtime source was also inspected from 50d6 Git blobs.
No parity, OS backdrop, focus, blur or native-child recovery claim.
